We tried Malaysian food at the market.
What language do people speak here?
I checked the word in my dictionary.
This phrase is useful when ordering food.

meaning: 意思疎通・コミュニケーション
example: Simple pictures can help with communication.
A misunderstanding led us to the wrong gate.

meaning: (気持ちや考えを表現するときの)身ぶり,手まね,しぐさ
example: He welcomed us with a friendly gesture.
Thanks for showing us the way.

meaning: (…に対する)わび,謝罪;言い訳,弁解
example: The hotel offered an apology for the delay.
Please excuse my poor pronunciation.
Welcome to our city!

meaning: (電話の応答で)もしもし;(あいさつ・呼びかけ・驚きの声などに用いて)こんにちは,やあ,おい,ちょっと,おや,まあ
example: Hello, is this the hotel reception?

meaning: さようなら,ごきげんよう
example: We waved goodbye to our guide.
No, this is not my suitcase.

meaning: 〈人が〉〈人〉を手伝う,助ける,の役に立つ
example: Could you help me find the station?
Beware of slippery steps.
I bought a lightweight suitcase.

meaning: 持ち運びのできる,携帯用の
example: We packed a portable charger.
Keep a spare key in your bag.
We caught an early train.

meaning: (定刻・通常・予定の時間より)遅れた,遅い
example: The last bus was late.
The weekly market is held on Sundays.

meaning: 月1回の,毎月の,月ぎめの
example: A monthly pass is cheaper for regular travelers.
The annual festival attracts many visitors.
Our flight arrives just before midnight.
We must leave the room by noon.
We started our hike at dawn.
We watched the sunrise from the beach.
The boat returns before sunset.

meaning: 朝,午前(午前0時または夜明けから正午まで)
example: The streets are quiet in the morning.

meaning: 夕方,夕刻,晩(日没から就寝時までの間)
example: We explored the market in the evening.
The city looks different at night.

meaning: 週末(通例金曜日の夕方から日曜日の夜まで);週末休暇
example: We are visiting friends this weekend.
The museum is open today.
We will leave tomorrow morning.
We arrived in the city yesterday.
The journey takes about an hour.
We spent a day at the beach.

meaning: (またcalendar month)(暦の上の1月から12月までのそれぞれの)月
example: The pass is valid for one month.

meaning: (グレゴリオ暦で1月1日に始まり12月31日に終わる)年,暦年(calendar year)
example: We visit this town every year.
The castle was built over a century ago.

meaning: (列車などの)時間表,時刻表;(授業などの)時間割り
example: Please check the ferry schedule.
The flight duration is about three hours.

meaning: (事と事の)間の時間,合い間;(物と物の)間の空間,間隔
example: There is a short interval between tours.

meaning: 時間帯・標準時の地域
example: Our destination is in a different time zone.
